caption: Omomyc shuts down DDR pathways and induces DNA damage (A) Microarray analysis of a panel of DDR-related gene sets treated with Omomyc mini-protein for 72 h in MDA-MB-231 cells as compared to vehicle-treated cells. (B) Microarray analysis of specific genes related to DDR in MDA-MB-231 cells treated with Omomyc for 72 h as compared to vehicle. (C) Western blot analysis of RAD51 and PARP1 protein in MDA-MB-231 (left), MX-1 (middle), and SUM149 (right) cells at 24 (top), 72 (middle), and 120 (bottom) h upon treatment with 30 μM Omomyc compared to vehicle. GAPDH was used as a loading control for each comparison. (D) Flow cytometry assessment of γH2AX+ cells when treating them for 24 or 72 h with 30 μM Omomyc as compared to vehicle-treated cells. From left to right: MDA-MB-231, MX-1, and SUM149PT cells are represented. Asterisks represent statistical significance of two-tailed t tests performed with GraphPad PRISM 9. ∗p < 0.05, ∗∗p < 0.01, and ∗∗∗p < 0.001; error bars, mean ± SD.
